name: [🌱] Roburbia [GARDENING]
desc:
BABIES CAN LEARN TO WALK, TALK AND MUCH MORE!

🌱 THE GARDEN UPDATE 🌱
Roburbia moved to a brand-new valley! Explore a bigger town with a river and a countryside: dirt roads, an old mill, a red barn and a pond to fish in.

🥕 GROW YOUR OWN GARDEN
Plant carrots, corn, pumpkins, cranberries, sunflowers and apple trees. Water them every day, harvest, then sell your basket or cook new recipes. Build garden beds, shelves and a glass greenhouse.

🏡 LIVE YOUR LIFE
Create your Roburbian, build and decorate your dream home, get a job, cook, fish and make friends in a cozy autumn town.

👶 RAISE YOUR BABIES
Adopt a baby, feed, bathe and play with them. Now they call you Mommy or Daddy, miss you and run to hug you. You can even carry two at once!

✨ ALSO NEW
Simple roofs, copy and paste, a new phone, hair and makeup at the mirror, and Cash gifts for friends.

Roburbia is in Beta, and more updates are on the way!

llm.loop: roleplay family life in a suburb -> care for babies, cook, build and decorate homes -> level up and claim season pass rewards
llm.objectives: live suburban life, raise babies and customize home and avatar
llm.progression: uncapped levels, 30-tier Harvest Pass, weekly XP race
llm.instructions: claim your first rewards; babies can walk and talk; try new recipes and oven baking
unique: babies that learn to walk and talk
weekly XP race in a town square
